# 110.45 Ideals generated by sets of idempotents and localization

Section 110.45 of the Stacks Project, [Tag 04QK](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/04QK). 1 tag here is carried by 1 declaration of the repository (in StacksFrontier), quoted below from [AxiomMath/Stacks](https://github.com/AxiomMath/Stacks) at commit [5ed82d14](https://github.com/AxiomMath/Stacks/tree/5ed82d14634e8d9576bb844c7bd4e3da66d450e7).

## Tag 04QL, a lemma

[Tag 04QL](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/04QL) in the Stacks Project.

**`Stacks.Examples.exists_ideal_locally_span_idempotents_not_globally`**, a theorem in StacksFrontier (drafted, not yet reviewed), declared in [StacksFrontier/Examples/Schemes/IdealLocallyGeneratedByIdempotents.lean, line 521](https://github.com/AxiomMath/Stacks/blob/5ed82d14634e8d9576bb844c7bd4e3da66d450e7/StacksFrontier/Examples/Schemes/IdealLocallyGeneratedByIdempotents.lean#L521).

> **Stacks 04QL.** A closed subscheme of an affine scheme can be locally, but not globally,
> cut out by ideals generated by idempotents.

```lean
theorem exists_ideal_locally_span_idempotents_not_globally :
    ∃ (R : Type u) (_ : CommRing R) (I : Ideal R),
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
        ∃ f : R, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
          ∃ s : Set (Localization.Away f),
            (∀ e ∈ s, IsIdempotentElem e) ∧
              Ideal.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f)) I = Ideal.span s) ∧
      ¬ ∃ s : Set R, (∀ e ∈ s, IsIdempotentElem e) ∧ I = Ideal.span s
```
